title: Embarrassment Limit Break
text: “What on earth happened?”

“Ah, right as Princess Melty tried to speak with Naofumi, the knight accompanying her revealed his true colors and tried to attack. Seems he was even planning to film it and fabricate evidence, but quick-handed Itsuki, well…”
Ren said this while filling his companions in, shooting Itsuki a pointed look. Itsuki just played innocent and looked away.
“You lot certainly seem to be having a grand old adventure with Rafumi-chan, don’t you?”
Ren shot his companions a resentful glare, needling them with sarcasm indeed.
“That is… we understand the circumstances.”
Faced with the jab, Ren’s companions gave a wry smile.
“Honestly… this is hardly the time for such nonsense.”
The one who looked like the sub-leader sighed.
“How shall I put it — the kingdom clearly believes it’s already won over Ren-sama and Kawasumi-sama, which is exactly why it’s resorting to a move like this.”
“Yeah.”
“Though in truth, all they’re doing is putting their own foolishness on full display. Hahaha.”
Itsuki kept his eyes fixed on them with pure contempt the whole time. Father, of all people, was the one trying to calm him down.
“So then… Rafumi-sama will be standing in for Ren-sama to settle this whole mess?”
“After getting fired up like that, I’m curious whether she can actually pull it off.”
“Heh… leave it to me. This self-serving, arrogant <justice> — I, the pitch-black King Azott — shall bring true <Ragnarok> retribution down upon the wicked <Three Saber> cult that rules this land.”
“Ohhh!”
Kuro-chan’s eyes sparkled at King Azott’s line. He looked like he was having the time of his life indeed.
“Rafumi-chan, I really don’t think you should be firing off words you barely understand just to get a rise out of Kuro-chan. Ren’s going to hit his embarrassment <Limit Break>.”

Ren, still caught in Luna-chan’s grip, trembled and quivered. He’d already reached the point of writhing in agony, hiding his face and ears. Luna-chan watched over him with an expression that said she found him utterly adorable, unable to help herself.
“Guh… Gaelion and Wyndia are useless!”
“Well, it is Gaelion, after all.”

I too felt a growing sense of dread, knowing it was only a matter of time before Rival showed up. Incidentally, Rival’s parent was, for what it was worth, present inside the circus along with Assistant. It had even been pulling the carriage during the whole incident, but Itsuki had cleaned everything up before it ever got the chance to step forward.
“Um… Heroes-sama, we’re truly sorry for all the trouble.”
“For this incident, we’ll escort the princess back and prove it was all a misunderstanding.”
Ren’s companions spoke while carefully reading the room.
“Ren-sama, we brought you a gift, so please cheer up.”
“Don’t say that and then hand me some unidentifiable bone as a gift!”
“Then how about this instead…”
“Don’t bring me a bone-shaped cookie either! I’m not Keel!”

Even Ren’s own companions seemed to have come to treat the real Ren as nothing more than a dog at this point, I say. And so Fiancée ended up going along together with Filo-tan and Rafumi’s group. Feeling a bit uneasy, I decided to tag along in stealth mode as well.
“Alright then, Melty-chan. Um… since Ren’s here, we’ll have him escort you back to the castle. Traveling with Sword Hero Ren should be safe enough, so please look after Filo for a while.”
“Yes. I’m sorry for the trouble this has caused. I’ll see to it that the warrants against the Heroes-sama are withdrawn as quickly as possible.”
“Yeah, that’d be great, but… just thinking about that princess being in the castle makes me uneasy. We’re sending someone skilled along too, so if things get dangerous, run for it right away, okay?”
“Do you mean my sister? Now that you mention it, she wasn’t in the castle.”
“Huh? She’s not there?”
“No.”
What?! What in the world does it mean that Crimson Swine isn’t in the castle?
“Well, that’s a bit of a relief, but where could she possibly be…? If she pulls anything strange, it won’t be a laughing matter.”
“I’m not entirely sure myself, but I heard she left the country before I even returned. It seems… she told Father she intended to ask a Hero she’s close with for help.”
“…I see. So this is what they mean by a clown.”
The Hero Crimson Swine was close to could only be Takt, without a doubt.

“Most likely, the Bow Hero she was cozy with made a fool of himself after the last Wave duel, the Shield Hero holds her in contempt, the Spear Hero hurls abuse at her, and the Sword Hero saw right through her… so she went running off to the Whip Hero, I’d wager.”

Incidentally, for the sake of mopping up Takt’s remnants, the information that Takt had already been dealt with as an enemy of the world rather than a Hero was currently being kept under wraps, indeed. Knowing Crimson Swine, she was probably taking her sweet time indulging in luxury en route to Faubrey. However, that meant her movements were a bit different from how Crimson Swine had behaved in previous loops. What could be causing that, I wondered. Well, Father had provoked Crimson Swine harder than ever this time around, so it wasn’t entirely strange that she’d act this way. One possibility: perhaps she’d tried offering up Éclair as a bargaining chip? No, wait… it also seemed plausible that Itsuki had vanished rather quickly, so they simply hadn’t crossed paths much. It was also possible that Ren, with Rafumi handling things in his stead, had chased her off as if utterly uninterested whenever she tried to approach. Crimson Swine was foolish, but perhaps she’d occasionally been making moves on the Heroes just to test whether she could successfully manipulate them, I say. And if all of that fizzled out, she might have been planning to head straight to Takt all along… that seemed plausible enough.
“At best she’ll get caught somewhere in the net closing around Takt’s remnants. No need to worry about her.”
“Well, that’s a relief.”
“I really did make an utter fool of myself! Hahaha!”
“Itsuki, quit it with the self-deprecating jokes too.”
“Come on now, here’s Naofumi-san’s shield~”
Itsuki clung to Father’s shield, continuing his self-deprecation. His self-pity had reached its absolute peak.
“Why did Itsuki turn out this way…?”
“He’s probably just spoiling himself on Naofumi.”
As Ren muttered this, Itsuki, seemingly regaining his composure, climbed back to his usual spot atop Father’s shoulders.
“Well now, will this get that odd warrant against Naofumi-san withdrawn, I wonder?”

“The warrant itself should be cleared up quickly enough by this country’s Queen’s order. More importantly, Princess Melty is returning, and with King Azott’s testimony besides, there shouldn’t be any issue.”
“Praise be to King Azott, is it.”
“Itsuki… you.”
Ren shot Itsuki a look of pure murderous intent.
“In any case, let’s be off. The gift for the King is ready too. Well then, shall we go? This King Azott shall deliver it safely into the King’s hands, fuhahaha…”
“Well then, Master, I’m off! Mel-chan, let’s go~”
With that, Rafumi climbed onto Kuro-chan’s back, and Fiancée set off for the castle together with Filo-tan. Worried as I was, I tagged along in stealth mode as well.
“Buu… I can sense Spear Guy nearby…”
“Filo-chan, it’s fine, let’s just go.”

And so, with King Azott in the lead, we began our journey indeed. Along the way… another prepared Rafumi joined up with us. Was that gift… that was it, wasn’t it? Was this really going to be alright? I felt a bit uneasy myself as we made our way there.
“Ohhhhh… Melty! You’ve made it back safe and sound! When word came that the soldiers had gone to Shield’s side only to find you missing, I could hardly keep myself together!”
“Father, as you can see, I’ve returned without so much as a scratch. Please, withdraw the warrant against Shield Hero-sama.”
“But Shield, Melty! Didn’t he trample all over your good intentions?!”
“No, Shield Hero-sama protected me from a knight who’d schemed to have me killed, and then… entrusted me to the Sword Hero-sama, who escorted me all the way back to the castle.”
“Heh… quite right. I, the devastatingly handsome Sword Hero Ren Amaki, simply received Princess Melty from Naofumi and delivered her here.”
If the real Ren had been present to hear that line, he’d surely have been fuming with rage.

On the way to the castle, Rafumi’s disguised Ren — handsome factor cranked up several notches — made his way through the castle town practically like a hero’s triumphant parade, tossing flirtatious glances all around indeed. Ren’s companions formed up in a protective formation around Fiancée, who rode atop Filo-tan, making the whole procession look like a proper triumphal march, and it seemed even the Three Heroes Church crowd had absolutely no chance of pulling off a surprise attack.
